Gets details of the Machine Group for the specified ID.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/machineGroup/:Id

Gets details of the Machine Group for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

Id
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the Machine Group.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.
